description: This file defines a data structure and functions for managing lists of strings. It provides APIs for creating, modifying, searching, sorting, filtering, and removing duplicates from both sorted and unsorted string lists. The file includes detailed documentation and macros for manipulating string lists, and handles memory management aspects like duplication and freeing of strings.

methods.name: string_list_init_nodup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list structure to the 'no duplicate' state, setting default values.

methods.name: string_list_init_dup
methods.description: Initializes a string_list structure with duplication enabled for added strings.

methods.name: filter_string_list
methods.description: Filters the string_list, retaining only items for which the callback returns true, and optionally frees utility pointers.

methods.name: string_list_clear
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the string_list and its items, with option to free 'util' members.

methods.name: string_list_clear_func
methods.description: Applies a custom clear function to each 'util' pointer in the list.

methods.name: string_list_setlen
methods.description: Adjusts the length of the string_list to a specified size, assuming ownership of underlying storage.

methods.name: for_each_string_list
methods.description: Applies a callback function to each item in the list, aborting if callback returns non-zero.

methods.name: string_list_remove_empty_items
methods.description: Removes items with empty strings from the list, optionally freeing 'util' members.

methods.name: string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks whether a sorted list contains a specific string.

methods.name: string_list_find_insert_index
methods.description: Finds the index where a new string should be inserted to maintain sorted order, optionally indicating if the string already exists.

methods.name: string_list_insert
methods.description: Inserts a string into the sorted list unless it already exists, returning the existing item if so.

methods.name: string_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from a sorted list, freeing resources if required.

methods.name: string_list_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a string in a sorted list and returns the associated item if found.

methods.name: string_list_remove_duplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate consecutive entries from a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append
methods.description: Appends a copy of a string to an unsorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append_nodup
methods.description: Appends a string to an unsorted list without copying, taking ownership if allocated.

methods.name: string_list_sort
methods.description: Sorts an unsorted list using the specified comparison function or default strcmp.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_has_string
methods.description: Checks if an unsorted list contains a specific string using linear search.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a string in an unsorted list using linear search.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_delete_item
methods.description: Deletes an item from an unsorted list at a specified index.

methods.name: string_list_split
methods.description: Splits a string into substrings based on delimiters and appends to the list.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place
methods.description: Splits a string in place by overwriting delimiters with NULs and appends substrings to the list.

methods.name: string_list_split_f
methods.description: Splits a string into substrings with options for trimming and ignoring empty strings.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place_f
methods.description: In-place string splitting with options, similar to string_list_split_f.
